//: Minimal Firebase config so the CLI can find firestore.indexes.json.
Deliberately declares ONLY indexes. There is no `rules` entry because there
is no firestore.rules file in this repository — adding one here would make
the CLI look for a file that does not exist and fail the deploy, and
generating a rules file from scratch would be worse: `firebase deploy` would
then overwrite whatever security rules are currently live in the console with
whatever a fresh scaffold contains. Indexes only, until the real rules are
The Firestore data itself is reached through the Admin SDK in server.js using
a service account, not through this config.
